'''Bay Fifty-Six''' was a landing bay within [[Whitestone City spaceport]] in [[Whitestone City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> during a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Battle for Poln Major|mission]] to the planet, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] secretly docked his [[Z-95-AF4 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] in Bay Fifty-Six. After his friend [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] correctly estimated that Skywalker had landed somewhere between Bays [[Bay fifty-two|Fifty-Two]] and [[Bay fifty-eight|Fifty-Eight]], his passenger the [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] [[Vestin Axlon]] revealed the exact bay number.<ref name="COO" />
